correctness.rationale: The 2N+1 rational confluent interpolation conditions at 0 and N pairwise-distinct positive squared nodes are nonsingular, giving a unique P of degree <=2N. Independent SymPy exact linear systems produced P_1,P_2,P_3 with degrees 2,4,6 and verified all data. Direct orbit substitution at A=(0,j²,0), B=(j,0,j²), C=(j,-j²,j²) gives prime-three cycles. The first two Jacobians coincide in a square-zero matrix, so the 3-return differential vanishes and polynomial Taylor remainder is quadratically contracting in a small neighborhood. Independent symbolic multiplication found (DF)^3=0 identically for unrestricted formal x,u,v. The polynomial coordinate conjugacy reduces fixed/2-cycle equations to zero; no numerical claim is used to establish all-N.
residual_risks: The construction proves at least N cycles, not an exact total count or global attraction.
